blurb: Cinézoo is a zoological park where guests can observe exotic animals trained for cinema and television. Visitors participate in guided tours revealing animal behaviors and filming anecdotes. The park offers regular and VIP visits, group outings, and educational activities year-round.
extraNote: Reservations required for all activities · Visits open rain or shine, all year round · Reservations modifiable up to 24 hours before visit · No food service on site; bring your own snacks and water · Cinézoo park at 141 5e Rang, Ste-Anne de la Rochelle, QC · Open all year, summer and winter, every day, rain or shine
